headline: 534 hospitalized as 3 more die of dengue in 24 hours
summary: The total death toll for the year has reached 50, with Dhaka division reporting the highest number of new admissions according to the DGHS.
details: Three people died from dengue in the last 24 hours, bringing the total death toll for the year to 50. The victims were from Barishal, Mymensingh, and Dhaka South City Corporation.

headline_marked: Chattogram's [[top criminal David Emon arrested]] in Jashore
headline: Chattogram's top criminal David Emon arrested in Jashore
summary: Mobarak Hossain, accused in multiple murders and extortion, was captured in a pre-dawn raid by joint police teams.
details: Law enforcers have arrested Mobarak Hossain, better known as David Emon, a listed 'top criminal' in Chattogram.
He was captured during a pre-dawn raid in the Jhumjhumpur area of Jashore by joint teams from the Jashore Kotwali Police Station and the district Detective Branch.
Mobarak is accused in at least seven criminal cases, including a double murder in Bakalia on March 30, 2025, and the killing of gangster Dhakaiya Akbar at Patenga beach on May 23, 2025.
Police report that Emon has access to 15-20 firearms and is highly skilled in handling weapons.
Investigators allege he arranged armed assailants and rented motorcycles for the Bakalia double murder.
He is considered one of two key figures leading criminal activities in Chattogram on behalf of fugitive gangster Boro Sazzad.
His group previously led by Chhoto Sazzad, now imprisoned, was allegedly taken over by Emon and Mohammad Raihanul Alam.
He is also linked to the July 13 vandalisation and looting of an internet service provider's office in Bakalia after the owner refused to pay Tk 2 crore extortion money.
